title: Believe God for Big Breakthroughs in 2026
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares the word of the Lord for 2026, encouraging listeners to believe God for big things in their lives and families. This powerful sermon will help you tap into the promises of God and align your faith with His plan for your future. Whether you're seeking a breakthrough, a new opportunity, or a fresh start, Pastor Zehner's message is sure to inspire and equip you to trust in God's goodness and provision.
